Types of css
1. External css
    -This is a separate css file that contains only style properties
    -Link the css file with the HTML file
    How do we link?
    <link rel="stylesheet" href"stlyle.css"

    CSS BOX model

    
    A box consists of four parts;

1. Content
2. padding
3. Border
4.margin

HOW TO DO THE CALCULATION(Cheat code)
1. content to be displayed.--> 320px(width of your content)
    - width(350px)
     - padding(20px10px --> left and right )
     - border (10px --> left and right)
    - height (80px)
     -content (50px)
      -padding(20px -->top and bottom)
      -border(10px -->top and bottom )
